notes.title: Patch 5/23/2020
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that left the Madness effect active even after overwriting it with another spell
Solitude now reads: Attack an adjacent enemy for 3 damage. If there aren't any adjacent enemies, gain 3 Actions instead.

notes.title: Patch 5/21/2020
notes.notes:
Rocklands-4 now can only spawn 1 Void Cultist, down from 2. The second cultist has been replaced by a Minotaur or Cyclops at random. 

I like this level and think it has an interesting and tense challenge where damage is almost always unavoidable. That said, it's frustrating to spawn right next to 2 Void Cultists and be unable to do anything about it. This patch will hopefully address that without harming the level.

notes.title: Patch 5/20/2020
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you to everyone that's bought the game! This is just a small patch to address some poorly worded spells, so nothing major is changing with this patch. If you encounter a bug, please report it in the Steam forums. Thanks!

Attempting to cast Ping now displays the correct popup
Fixed a typo in the tutorial
Reworded the "Choose" button in Custom Mode to "Choose Spells"
Reworded Stream of Mana
Reworded Dream of Future
Reworded Gust of Wind
Reworded Abracadabra
Reworded Chaos
Reworded Flamecasting
